title: Yawaitar da Ta Bace
intro: Kana tsaye a gaban kururuwar al'umma wadda labarinta ya kasance a cikin raƙuman ruwa. Waɗannan rayuka sun ji kira, sun zaɓi rashin amincewa, kuma sun fuskanci sakamakon da ya sake fasalin duniya. Su wanene su, kuma me ya faru da duniyarsu?
clues: Mun rayu tun da daɗewa, kuma wani manzo ya zo mana daga cikinmu.
Mun bauta wa gumaka biyar kuma muka ƙi barinsu.
Mun yi wa manzon ba'a kuma muka zarge shi da ɓata hanya.
Mun nemi ya kawo hukuncin idan yana da gaskiya.
Mun ga sama tana zuba ruwa, ƙasa kuma tana fitar da maɓuɓɓugan ruwa.
Mun hau zuwa wuraren tsafi don mu tsira, amma raƙuman ruwa suka mamaye mu.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: An nutsar da mu cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai girma
An kashe mu da babbar fashewa
An yi mana jifa da duwatsu daga sama
trial.answer: An nutsar da mu cikin ambaliyar ruwa mai girma

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Duk mun halaka sai muminai tare da Nuhu
An bar mu a matsayin kango ga matafiya
outcome.answer: Duk mun halaka sai muminai tare da Nuhu

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
